import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Prepare data
X = train_df["comment_text"].fillna(" ")
y = train_df[target_cols].values

# Split into train and validation sets (stratified isn't possible for multi-label, so random split)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Create improved TF-IDF features with broader ngram and more features
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=30000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    use_idf=True,
    smooth_idf=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit on training data only
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["comment_text"].fillna(" "))

# Train multi-output logistic regression with explicit balanced class weights and stronger regularization
clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000,
        solver="lbfgs",
        C=10.0,  # weaker regularization to fit rare classes better
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
    ),
    n_jobs=-1,
)
clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)

# Calculate column-wise ROC AUC
auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(score)
    print(f"{col}: {score:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission file
submission = sample_submission.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission[col] = test_preds[:, i]

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission file saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
